entities.name: Drone
entities.rationale: Drone icon drawn at left of dashed vertical line, above the 3rd party computer; captures data that is uploaded to S3. Outside the AWS area (left of dashed divider).

entities.name: 3rd Party
entities.rationale: Computer/workstation icon labeled '3rd Party' in green handwriting, left of the dashed vertical divider (external to AWS). Grouped visually with the drone.

entities.name: CloudWatch Event
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'CLOUDWATCH EVENT' (AWS_Icon_4), right of dashed divider; scheduled event that triggers Step Functions.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3' (AWS_Icon_7), top center.

entities.name: Storage Gateway
entities.rationale: Green icon labeled 'STORAGE GATEWAY' (AWS_Icon_6), right of S3.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Pink icon labeled 'STEP FUNCTIONS' (AWS_Icon_2), center.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'LAMBDA' (AWS_Icon_1), below-right of Step Functions.

entities.name: On-Premises (Server + Database box)
entities.rationale: White rectangular box on the right containing the 'SERVER' and 'DATABASE' icons; represents the on-premises environment container.

entities.name: Server
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'SERVER' (AWS_Icon_5) drawn inside the white on-premises box, above Database.

entities.name: Database
entities.rationale: Icon labeled 'DATABASE' drawn inside the white on-premises box, below Server.

visual_connections.description: Curved arrow arcing from the drone over the top to the S3 bucket (drone data upload).
Green bracket-shaped arrow on the left side going from the drone down to the 3rd party computer.
Green arrow from the top of CloudWatch Event curving down into Step Functions (scheduled trigger).
Curved arrow from Step Functions over to the Lambda icon (workflow invokes Lambda).
Curved line from above Lambda up to the arrowhead beneath S3 (Lambda accesses S3 data).
Short arrow pointing left from Storage Gateway to S3.
Arrow from the top of the on-premises box (Server) up to Storage Gateway.
Long green curved line between the area beneath S3 and the Database/on-premises box, with arrowheads at both ends.
Green curved arrow from the left of Lambda sweeping along the bottom back to the 3rd party side (with a small handwritten label, likely 'API').
